question.text: Which form must be submitted by an individual who does not have a PAN and is applying for one for the first time?

explanation.text: The Logic: Form 49A is the prescribed form to apply for a PAN. Form 60 and Form 61 are declarations used when PAN is unavailable for specified transactions, not application forms for PAN itself. The Trap: Candidates often confuse Form 49A (the application for PAN) with Form 60 / Form 61, which are the declarations a person submits in lieu of PAN for certain transactions where PAN is otherwise required. Note: Source basis is p.296 (Form 49A as the PAN application form) and p.297 (Form 60 / Form 61 as declarations when PAN is unavailable for specified transactions) of the NISM-Series-X-A Investment Adviser (Level 1) workbook (June 2025).
